notes: The unit selects r01, which supplies πάντα, so the ASV's italicized *all* is aligned rather than added; rule 11 makes the italics evidence only.

τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ δείπνου → *at supper time* leaves both articles unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV writing no determiner, and keeps the case preposition with ὥρᾳ under rule 21's determinerless clause — the same reading 14:5 takes.
